[Source: Yogasutra.janvier. 2020.pdf, éd. 2021.pdf | Section: Yoga-Sūtra II.17 (Sādhanapāda) — Draṣṭṛdṛśyayoḥ saṃyogo heyahetuḥ | Pages 442-449]

ravṛttasya duḥkhahetusaṃyogasyocchedo na śakyasaṃbhāvana ity āśayena
pṛcchati prasaṅgāt tacchakyatvam avadhārayitum-- kasmād iti / Uttaram-- duḥkhahetor iti /
Parihāryasyety anena prakṛtyādinityavyāvṛttiḥ tathā ca duḥkhahetutvanityatvaliṅgena saṃyogasya
śakyocchedakatvam anumeyam ity āśayaḥ / Duḥkhahetoḥ pratīkāryatve laukikam udāharaṇam āha--
tad yatheti / Bhedyatvaṃ bhedajaduḥkhabhāgitvaṃ bhettṛtvaṃ ca bhedadvārā duḥkhahetutvaṃ
pādānadhiṣṭhānaṃ
pādenānārohaṇam,
pādatrāṇam
upānat,
tadvyavahitena
vā
padā
kaṇṭakasyārohaṇam ity arthaḥ / Etat trayaṃ duḥkhāśrayaduḥkhahetutatparīhāropāyarūpam ity arthaḥ
/ Yo vedety anenaitat
